regulation.speedLimitDescription: Set speed limits for each road variant. These limits also apply to paths already built, except those with an individually assigned limit.
regulation.buildingRegulationDescription: Height limit, volume ratio and coverage ratio are the defaults for newly created districts. Existing districts are not affected; change those from the district panel. The parking requirement applies citywide: new buildings for tenants must provide parking equal to this share of their total floor area. Whatever the open space on the site cannot hold is taken from the rentable floors.
regulation.immigrationDescription: Set conditions for accepting immigrant households. Applicants that do not meet these conditions will be rejected.
regulation.immigrationSkillHint: Applicants with at least one skill meeting the threshold are accepted (OR condition). Immigrant household heads usually have skills of 1.0 or less
regulation.welfareDescription: Set the cash transfer policies from the city to households (unemployment benefits, pensions, livelihood assistance). Benefits are paid within the social security budget and scaled down proportionally when the budget ratio is reduced.
regulation.welfareShortfallRatioUnit: % of shortfall to minimum living cost
regulation.welfareHint: Unemployment benefits go to citizens of working age below retirement age who have neither a job nor a school. Pensions go to citizens at or above retirement age. Livelihood assistance tops up households whose cash plus benefits fall short of the minimum living cost.
regulation.repairDescription: Set the durability threshold at which public buildings and roads begin repair. When durability falls below the threshold, repair starts probabilistically.
